sloka: स्ततः क्रुद्धा निशाचराः ।अन्ये भेरीः समाजघ्नुरन्ये चक्रुर्महास्वनम् ।केशानन्ये प्रलुलुपुः कर्णावन्ये दशन्ति च ।। ६.६०.५२ ।।।।
transliteration: stataḥ kruddhā niśācarāḥ ।anye bherīḥ samājaghnuranye cakrurmahāsvanam ।keśānanye pralulupuḥ karṇāvanye daśanti ca ।। 6.60.52 ।।।।

translations.english: Some had their nails fixed with mallets, letting their mallets fall on the forehead, on the chest and throw at of Kumbhakarna.
